bootstrap.unit: 20 paired persona blocks shared across amounts and models

sampling: Equal persona weights; five draws per cell. Valid-conditional rates plus planned-denominator unknown-answer bounds.
diagnostics: P(k), known-zero versus no-info, increments, S2/S3 with core admissibility guard, rho with denominator guard.
comparisons: 20 exploratory amount-minus-500MB contrasts: 2 models x 2 amounts x 5 conditions; centered bootstrap and Holm. Undefined/degenerate tests remain unavailable, not p=0.
boundary: All-identical cell bootstrap does not prove probability zero/one or equivalence; show conditional exact-binomial bounds.
sensitivity: Strict labels and all-invalid-as-Yes/No. Do not pool top-token scores with sampling. Pause inference if invalid new replies exceed 1%.
limits: Within one synthetic coupon scenario, two held-out amounts; no cross-domain or unseen-persona validation.
R1/w1 and P1 only; cannot replicate R2 representation effects, three-wording stability, P1/P0 interaction or D.
Matched 500MB controls reuse only the same 20 core personas and w1; not the full 100-persona average.
All-success and unstable-IC cases remain uncertain; no equivalence or human-calibration claim.
No prompt tuning, outcome-dependent stopping, bridge k=4..6, macro run or RCA in this task.
